name: PackFloat
evidence: packs a float taken apart (kind, sign, exponent, fraction) back into its 32 bits (soft_float_single.c)

name: UnpackFloat
evidence: takes a float's 32 bits apart into kind, sign, unbiased exponent and fraction (soft_float_single.c)

name: ConvertFloatToU32
evidence: converts a float to an unsigned 32-bit integer (CancelPauseMenuPage calls it)

name: PackFloatFromParts
evidence: packs a float from a kind, sign, exponent and fraction passed as loose arguments (the double to float conversion calls it)

name: ConvertFloatToDouble
evidence: unpacks a float and packs its parts as a double with PackDoubleFromParts, the fraction shifted up 30 bits (soft_float_single.c)
